lines.t:
Each team enters 3 or fewer <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c>, and both
teams choose one of them as the <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c>.

The team that first gets the rival {{leader}} <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>
{{wins}}.

The winning team can take as many <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> from the
losing team as the number of {{medabot|pl}} it knocked
out.
